app_store.name: Creative Activities
app_store.subtitle: Farsamo & ciyaaraha sawirka
app_store.promotional_text: Wada samaysta wax: waxqabado hal-abuur ah oo fudud, tiles sawir waaweyn iyo sawirada qoyskaaga. Saacad xisaabeed ma jirto, dhibco ma jiraan, akoon looma baahna.
app_store.description:
Hel waxqabad fudud oo aad wada ku raaxaysataan. Creative Activities waxay qoysaska iyo daryeelayaasha u bixisaa isku-mid-ka sawirrada ee deggan iyo wada-fiirinta sawirrada, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa la nool qof qaba dementia ama cudurka Alzheimer.

Ku bilow yar
Ku bilow afar tile oo waaweyn iyo sawirro bilow ah oo la yaqaan. Sawirrada ka dhig kuwo muuqda, ama qari marka ay ku habboon tahay. Habka deggan ma laha saacad xisaabeed, dhibco ama ganaax. Dooro 4, 6, 8 ama 12 tile sida ay diyaar u yihiin.

Ka dhig mid shakhsi ah
Ku dooro sawirrada qoyska qalabkaaga doorashada sawirka. Creative Activities waxay u kaydisaa nuqullo yaryar howlaha gudaha; ma baadho maktabadaada, mana beddesho sawirradaada asalka ah. Hal ururin waxaad ku haysan kartaa ilaa 24 sawir.

Wada fiiri
Fiiri hal sawir markiiba. Su'aalaha doodda ee ikhtiyaarka ah waxay casuumaan wada hadal iyada oo aan lagu weydiin in la xusuusto magacyo ama la bixiyo jawaab sax ah. Si fudud u fiirintu waa ku filan tahay.

Khadka la'aan meesha ay muhiimka tahay
Sawirrada bilowga ah isla markiiba waa diyaar. Nuqullada sawirrada la soo geliyay waxay shaqeeyaan khadka la'aan ka dib soo gelinta. Dooridda sawirrada asalka ah ee iCloud oo keliya ku kaydsan waxay u baahan kartaa internet. Dhammaan siddeedda xirmo sawir waxay la socdaan app-ka, iyada oo aan wax soo dejin sawir oo gooni ah jirin.

Akoon ma jiro, server sawir isku-xidhayna ma jiro
Nuqullada sawirrada qoyska waxay ku hadhaan app-ka qalabkan. Waad tirtiri kartaa nuqullada adigoon tirtirin sawirrada asalka ah. Kaabayaasha qalabka waxay ka koobnaan karaan xogta app-ka. Nooca hadda ma isku xidho sawirrada u dhexeeya qaraabada.

Creative Activities waxay u tahay madadaalo iyo wada hadal wadaag ah. Ma baarto, ma daaweyso, ma ka hortagto, mana cabbiro dementia ama cudurka Alzheimer. Waxqabaduhu ma ku habboona qof walba; raac xiisaha iyo raaxada qofka, oo jooji ama beddel waxqabadka marka loo baahdo.
app_store.release_notes: Clearer screens for playing together. The first picture game spreads each pair apart. Plan my day, Daily moment and other pages fit better with large text, and text follows your phone's size up to twice the normal size. Look together no longer counts the pictures. In Today, help numbers are labelled for the U.S., with a note to use a local number elsewhere. Translations are machine-made and not yet reviewed. If anything reads wrong, tell us from Help and privacy.
